purpose: Teach: 太る/引っかかる/ほた/スミマセン/ひねり/広々/昇っ/すれ違う

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、最近少し太る気がするわ
lines.en: Sho, I think I've been putting on a little weight lately.
lines.style: Wry observation about herself, self-aware but not self-pitying. Light, conversational tone. The kind of thing you say to someone you trust not to contradict you immediately.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵筆が画板に引っかかる位置に置いちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I accidentally left my paintbrush in a spot where it catches on the canvas board.
lines.style: Quiet report of a small mishap. Matter-of-fact, the way a child describes something he's noticed but isn't sure matters. No dramatic pause—just factual.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは「ほた、見て」って、絵を見せて下さるのよ
lines.en: Sho, what Mei-sis does is show you her art and say 'look'—and then she really means it.
lines.style: Tender recognition of a habit, like she's noticing something about herself through his eyes. Gentle certainty. A small smile in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描き失敗して「スミマセン」って
lines.en: Mei-sis, I messed up my drawing and just said 'sorry' over and over.
lines.style: Small, earnest admission. A child's genuine regret, not looking for reassurance, just being honest. The quietness of someone who feels he let someone down.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの絵には、ひねりがあるのよ
lines.en: Sho, there's something clever in the way Mei-sis draws. A twist to it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself. She's appreciating something she's noticed—not lecturing, just thinking aloud. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、メイ姉さんのアトリエ、広々して素敵だね
lines.en: Mei-sis, your atelier is so big and bright. It's really lovely.
lines.style: Genuine praise from a child, unselfconscious. A real compliment, the kind offered without expectation of anything back. Warmth and sincerity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんとお山に昇って絵を描きたいね
lines.en: Sho, I want to climb up the mountain with Mei-sis and paint up there.
lines.style: Wistful, imagining out loud. The kind of thought that floats up when you're with someone who makes you want to create. Soft, hopeful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんと公園ですれ違う時、必ず手を振るよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, whenever I see you passing by the park, I always wave at you.
lines.style: Earnest promise, delivered with quiet consistency. Not performative—the certainty of something he actually does. Eager to be seen and remembered.
